_doc: Facts a finished town must show to match its civ line (lab evaluation only; the builder never reads this). Generic check names, one meaning each: ring_closed (no way out from the civic centre except gates), gates_only_at (sides where gates may be), gates_max, gate_max_m (widest opening that is still a gate), inside_max_m2 (closed inside area around the civic centre, m2; (30+2x15)^2-30^2 = 2700 = a ring at most 15 m out); an opening narrower than 6 m is a slit, reported but not counted as a gate (lattice leftovers next to Petra's free-placed buildings; a street is ~10 m), houses_side_by_side_min (share of houses touching another side by side), houses_touching_max (houses touching another, side or corner), next_to_field_or_wood_min (share within 6 m of a field or 10 m of trees).

town._doc: v1's measures (strategos/mvp1 city.js) for a town run (city_real.py --town): ring pieces = City Planner buildings only (fields and Petra's other buildings never count). Openings = ways out of the city from the civic centre between all City Planner buildings (walls grown 1 m, so gaps up to 2 m are closed); ring 0 = pieces starting before the innermost piece's outer face (square distance), used for the street check. ring_closed: no way out except the openings found; openings_max: at most that many; gates_at: exactly one opening on each of these sides and none elsewhere (no corner); gate_m: an opening's width range (v1: a 10 m street widened by a leftover shorter than its largest building + gap, 20 + 1 m: 10-31 m; narrower than 8 m is a slit, not a street); street_m + street_share_min: the gap from each ring-1 piece to the ring-0 piece straight inward (v1: 10 m).
town._doc_relative: Relative score (round 14+): Jev's town vs v1's own town (city_v1.py) on the same snapshot and timeline; pass = Jev at least as good on every measure: openings (count of ways out, lower), open_m (their total width, lower), gate_sides (front / left flank / right flank sides with an opening of gate_m width, higher), corner_back (openings at a corner or on the back, lower), street_share (ring-1 buildings 8-12 m from ring 0, higher). Up to 16 ways out are counted.
town._doc_terrain: Round 23+: stone and metal mines are walls in the ways-out flood (terrain units cannot cross; 5 m half-size squares, inside the builder's 6 m clearance), for Jev's town and v1's alike; they are never ring pieces. Fields still do not block (BlockMovement false).
